fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.desc: Main Fire nuke with a cast time and a small burn. Damage lowered in Forever.

frostarmor.name: Frost Armor
frostarmor.desc: 30-min armor buff that chills melee attackers. Ice Armor replaces it at 30.

arcaneintellect.name: Arcane Intellect
arcaneintellect.desc: Intellect buff on one target. Lasts 1 hour in Forever (was 30 min).

conjurewater.name: Conjure Water
conjurewater.desc: Conjures water to drink; more bottles per cast in Forever.

frostbolt.name: Frostbolt
frostbolt.desc: Frost nuke that slows the target's movement.

conjurefood.name: Conjure Food
conjurefood.desc: Conjures food to eat out of combat.

fireblast.name: Fire Blast
fireblast.desc: Instant Fire damage on an 8 sec cooldown. Shares that cooldown with Ice Lance in Forever.

comprehendscroll.name: Comprehend Scroll
comprehendscroll.desc: New in Forever: decipher a scroll you looted, training the Comprehension skill.

polymorph.name: Polymorph
polymorph.desc: Turns an enemy humanoid or beast into a sheep. Breaks on damage.

dampenmagic.name: Dampen Magic
dampenmagic.desc: Party buff: less spell damage and less healing taken. Stronger in Forever.

slowfall.name: Slow Fall
slowfall.desc: Slows your falling speed for 30 sec.

arcaneexplosion.name: Arcane Explosion
arcaneexplosion.desc: Instant Arcane damage to all enemies around you.

flamestrike.name: Flamestrike
flamestrike.desc: Ground-targeted Fire damage plus a burn. Ignite can now apply to its burn in Forever.

amplifymagic.name: Amplify Magic
amplifymagic.desc: Party buff: more spell damage and more healing taken. Stronger in Forever.

removelessercurse.name: Remove Lesser Curse
removelessercurse.desc: Removes one curse from a friendly target.

blink.name: Blink
blink.desc: Teleport 20 yards forward and break stuns and roots.

manashield.name: Mana Shield
manashield.desc: Absorbs physical damage by draining your mana.

scorch.name: Scorch
scorch.desc: Fast Fire nuke. Damage lowered in Forever.

counterspell.name: Counterspell
counterspell.desc: Interrupts a cast and locks that school for 10 sec.

coneofcold.name: Cone of Cold
coneofcold.desc: Frost damage and a slow in a cone. Shorter, weaker slow in Forever.

conjuremanaagate.name: Conjure Mana Agate
conjuremanaagate.desc: Conjures a Mana Agate, a gem you use to restore mana.

icearmor.name: Ice Armor
icearmor.desc: Stronger armor buff that chills melee attackers. Replaces Frost Armor.

magearmor.name: Mage Armor
magearmor.desc: Armor buff for resistances and mana regeneration while casting. Regen raised to 50% in Forever.

conjuremanajade.name: Conjure Mana Jade
conjuremanajade.desc: Conjures a Mana Jade, a gem you use to restore mana.

frostfirebolt.name: Frostfire Bolt
frostfirebolt.desc: New in Forever: a 3 sec Fire and Frost nuke with a slow and a burn, checked against the lower resistance.

portalstormwind.name: Portal: Stormwind
portalstormwind.desc: Opens a portal to Stormwind for your group.

portalironforge.name: Portal: Ironforge
portalironforge.desc: Opens a portal to Ironforge for your group.

portalorgrimmar.name: Portal: Orgrimmar
portalorgrimmar.desc: Opens a portal to Orgrimmar for your group.

portalundercity.name: Portal: Undercity
portalundercity.desc: Opens a portal to Undercity for your group.

conjuremanacitrine.name: Conjure Mana Citrine
conjuremanacitrine.desc: Conjures a Mana Citrine, a gem you use to restore mana.

portaldarnassus.name: Portal: Darnassus
portaldarnassus.desc: Opens a portal to Darnassus for your group.

portalthunderbluff.name: Portal: Thunder Bluff
portalthunderbluff.desc: Opens a portal to Thunder Bluff for your group.

teleportdalaran.name: Teleport: Dalaran
teleportdalaran.desc: New in Forever: teleports you to Dalaran, which both factions can visit.

arcanebrilliance.name: Arcane Brilliance
arcanebrilliance.desc: Intellect buff for your whole party or raid.

conjuremanaruby.name: Conjure Mana Ruby
conjuremanaruby.desc: Conjures a Mana Ruby, a gem you use to restore mana.

arcaneblast.name: Arcane Blast
arcaneblast.desc: New in Forever: 1.5 sec Arcane nuke. Each cast stacks Spell Damage and raises its own mana cost, up to 4 stacks.

arcanewrath.name: Arcane Wrath
arcanewrath.desc: New in Forever: 3.5 sec Arcane projectile on a 6 sec cooldown that scales with your maximum mana.

presenceofmind.name: Presence of Mind
presenceofmind.desc: Makes your next spell with a cast time instant.

arcanepower.name: Arcane Power
arcanepower.desc: 15 sec: spells deal 30% more damage and cost 30% more mana.

pyroblast.name: Pyroblast
pyroblast.desc: Huge, slow Fire nuke with a burn. Heating Up crits shorten its cast in Forever.

blastwave.name: Blast Wave
blastwave.desc: Instant Fire damage and a daze to enemies around you.

combustion.name: Combustion
combustion.desc: Each Fire spell hit raises your Fire crit chance until you have scored several crits.

icelance.name: Ice Lance
icelance.desc: New in Forever: instant Frost hit that does 300% damage to Frozen targets. 8 sec cooldown shared with Fire Blast.

iceblock.name: Ice Block
iceblock.desc: Become immune to everything for 10 sec but unable to act. Moved up a tier in Forever.

coldsnap.name: Cold Snap
coldsnap.desc: Resets the cooldowns of your Frost spells. 10 min cooldown and moved down to tier 5 in Forever.

icebarrier.name: Ice Barrier
icebarrier.desc: Damage shield that also raises Frost damage and stops pushback in Forever.
